description: Hi, I'm Tasneem, a builder from Qatar who loves turning big ideas into simple apps that real people can use. I build web apps with AI, React and computer vision, and I just shipped a live AI makeup coach. I'm drawn to Field Shift because farmers here face less water and hotter summers every year. I'd love teammates who enjoy Python and NASA data, design, or storytelling. Let's build something that matters and have fun doing it!
